subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who believes in the existence of a god or gods
solution:
The correct answer is **"Theist"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question is asking for **someone who ****believes in god or gods**.
 
• **Theists** hold that there is/are a god or gods.
 
 
• ***Example:** John was a theist.*
 
 
 
• Both the meanings are the same.
 
• So the correct option is **3)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see the others' meaning.

 
• A **linguist** is a person who is skilled in languages.

 
 
• ***Example: **Ram was an accomplished linguist.*
 
 
 
• **Atheist **refers to a person who does not believe in the **existence of any gods**.
 
 
• ***Example:** I am an **a****theist**.*
 
 
 
• **Leftist** refers to a person with **left-leaning political opinions**.
 
 
• ***Example:** We are looking for something to distinguish them from other **leftists**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, these three options are not matching with the given question.
